plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full larkfit-mobile system, prioritizing the primary docs/tutorial flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will systematically test the single-page application by navigating through the four main bottom tabs (Today, Workouts, Activity, You). It will interact with actionable elements on each screen, such as workout play buttons and profile inputs. Finally, it will verify layout constraints and touch target sizes, especially considering the mobile-first design.
assumptions: The application is a single HTML file (index.html) that uses JavaScript to switch between screens based on the bottom tab bar clicks.
The 2 inputs mentioned in the prescan are located within the 'You' (profile/settings) tab.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (e.g., the '+' button and '▶' play buttons) that trigger layout warnings
Visibility and stickiness of the bottom 4-tab navigation bar during scrolling
Scrolling behavior within the simulated mobile frame on desktop vs. native edge-to-edge on mobile

phases.title: Bottom Tab Navigation Validation
phases.objective: Verify that all four bottom tabs correctly switch the visible screen content.
key_checks: Click '▶ Workouts', '📊 Activity', and '◉ You' tabs sequentially
Verify headings change (e.g., 'Workouts', 'Activity', 'You') to confirm screen transitions
exit_criteria: All four tabs have been clicked and their corresponding main headings are confirmed visible.

phases.title: Today Screen Interactions
phases.objective: Explore actionable elements on the default 'Today' dashboard.
key_checks: Click the '+' button at the top
Click the '▶' play button next to 'Easy 5K' or 'Hip-mobility flow'
Check if a modal, workout active state, or new view appears
exit_criteria: Primary action buttons on the Today screen have been triggered and state changes recorded.

phases.title: Workouts and Activity Exploration
phases.objective: Investigate content and interactions within the Workouts and Activity screens.
key_checks: Navigate to 'Workouts', click on a workout card (e.g., 'Easy 5K · recovery') to check for detail views
Navigate to 'Activity', look for interactive charts, 'Recent' logs, or '30-day intensity' filters
exit_criteria: Both screens have been scrolled and any visible interactive lists or charts tested.

phases.title: Profile and Settings (You Tab)
phases.objective: Test form inputs and preference toggles on the user profile screen.
key_checks: Identify and interact with the 2 inputs found in the prescan
exit_criteria: Inputs have been focused/modified and settings toggles clicked.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit index.html and trigger all 4 main virtual screens via the tab bar.
coverage_targets.features: Exercise workout playback buttons, quick add (+), tab navigation, and settings inputs.
coverage_targets.mobile: Ensure the UI functions correctly in a mobile viewport, paying attention to the bottom bar and tap targets.

notes: Since this is a mobile fixture, be mindful of scrolling within specific elements if the main body does not scroll.
Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets (< 44px) when evaluating UX.
